lines.text: This line was drawn by thousands of people who never met.
chunks: This line was drawn by|thousands of people

lines.text: And this is the path they were given.
chunks: And this is the path|they were given.

lines.text: The paved one is perfect. Right angles, every time.
The same plan, poured in park after park.
chunks: The same plan, poured|in park after park.

lines.text: It cuts the corner, because a diagonal is shorter.
chunks: It cuts the corner,|because a diagonal

lines.text: It bends where the rain collects.
It's wider where strangers stepped aside to pass.
Nobody planned it. Nobody voted on it.
Each walker just pressed the grass a little flatter.
Planners even have a name for it. Desire paths.
chunks: Planners even have|a name for it.

lines.text: We don't walk where we're told. We walk where we mean to go.
chunks: We walk where|we mean to go.

lines.text: A worn path is proof that someone was here, and the next person agreed.
A plan can be copied anywhere. The reasons we walk can't.
The straightest lines in a city are drawn by planners. The truest ones are drawn by people.
chunks: The truest ones|are drawn by people.
